description: This file is a PHP source code defining a controller class 'Fraud' within the OpenCart admin extension for fraud detection management. It handles listing, installing, and uninstalling fraud extensions, including managing permissions, loading necessary components, and rendering views.

classes.name: Fraud
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing fraud detection extensions in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the fraud extensions list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares data for displaying all fraud extensions, including their statuses, installation links, and permissions.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation of a fraud extension, including permission setup, autoload registration, and optional installation routines.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation of a fraud extension, including permission removal and calling the extension's uninstall method.
